summary: National Grid plc filed a Form 6-K on 3 August 2026 announcing an internal operating-model simplification effective 1 September 2026. The Group Executive Committee shrinks from 13 to 8 members; new UK and US Presidents, a Global Capital President, and a Chief Technology and Innovation Officer are appointed. No external transaction, tender, activist, or strategic review is involved. This is routine organizational restructuring with board-level appointments, not a special situation. What to watch: potential management changes are internal realignments; no impact on shareholders' equity or capital structure.
